note: The fuzzer-created font contains a morx noncontextual lookup and shaping supplies buffer glyph ids that drive this lookup.
The candidate sets the lookup format field to 2, routing the glyph id into the segment binary-search implementation.
The sanitizer accepts an input-controlled unitSize smaller than the LookupSegmentSingle record size, so only part of each segment is required to be initialized and in range.
The undersized unitSize is used as the stride to form a LookupSegmentSingle pointer even though the checked record contains fewer bytes than that type.
The comparison reads the first field from bytes that were not covered by the undersized unit validation, triggering an uninitialized-value use.
